They wanted to solve customers’ problems with American-made, high-tech solutions and extraordinary customer service, from development to installation and beyond. These were the forward-thinking goals that launched a new and different kind of company. It’s what set Belco apart then, and continues to set us apart today. We are Belco. The Systems Solution People. As a [custom machine builder in Belding, MI](/), we strive to always provide the best experience for our customers. [![Belco Powder Coating System](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20504%20360'%3E%3C/svg%3E)](https://youtu.be/rhWppNC5IPA?autoplay=1) [![Belco Aluminum Extrusion](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20504%20360'%3E%3C/svg%3E)](https://youtu.be/UxZXMSPLkCE?autoplay=1) ### Our Service Just as our founders did back in 1959, we strive to give every project the highest level of service and follow-up support. Today, from our over 70,000-square-foot facility in Belding, Michigan, Belco serves multiple locations nationwide and continues to proudly build not only the most technologically advanced products in the industry, but strong, long-term relationships as well. We’re there from start to finish, standing behind our products from the drawing board to the customer’s shop floor. Unlike others in the **aluminum extrusion** and paint industries, Belco offers flexibility, providing complete turnkey systems or when needed, retrofitting equipment and custom designing solutions to fit customer needs. We will do whatever it takes for our customers to succeed because we firmly believe that if they fail, so do we. [![Electrocoat Systems Worldwide](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20504%20360'%3E%3C/svg%3E)](https://youtu.be/apzagmmgtcw?autoplay=1) [![Commercial Paint Booths Worldwide](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20504%20360'%3E%3C/svg%3E)](https://youtu.be/9LSYtvei6KA?autoplay=1) [![Electrocoat Systems Worldwide](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20504%20360'%3E%3C/svg%3E)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6C8ogT6eyTo&t?autoplay=1) [![Commercial Paint Booths Worldwide](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20504%20360'%3E%3C/svg%3E)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p82C4pk5xN8&?autoplay=1) ### Our Products Belco has a reputation of being easy to work with, being available 24/7 and having the safest, most reliable and long-lasting equipment that can be found. Belco products not only set industry standards, but continuously raise the bar. Our products go above and beyond manufacturing requirements, minimize floor space, and offer the lowest operating costs possible. Our undying commitment to exceptional customer support, diversified product line, and willingness to respond to the growing and changing demands of the industries we serve makes Belco an industry leader. ### Aluminum Extrusion World renowned in the [aluminum extrusion](/extrusion-overview/) industry, Belco [aluminum extrusion products](/extrusion-overview/) and systems maximize productivity by minimizing downtime and reducing scrap. #### Products include, but are not limited to: * Billet/Log Furnaces * Furnaces * Handling Systems * Log Saws * Die Ovens * Age Ovens * Pullers * Air Quench Systems ### Finishing Our paint and [powder finishing](/powder-coating-systems/) expertise has earned us widespread respect in the industry and our products are considered top-of-the-line, ideal for manufacturers of metal furniture, automotive components, and other metal and plastic parts. #### Products include, but are not limited to: * Custom Washers * Ovens * Paint Spray Booths ## Our Promise ### Superior Products & Service [Belco Industries](/) was founded on a very basic concept…design, engineer, and manufacture quality equipment that exceeds customer expectations while offering years of dependable service. Since the beginning, Belco has manufactured literally hundreds of systems for clients, from start-up ventures to Fortune 500 companies all around the world. Whether you’re a small company or a giant corporation, we promise to provide innovative solutions that meet your unique needs and stand by them through concept, delivery, installation, and support. We’ll be there for as long as you may need us. ### Value European companies may give you a lower price, but they also give you zero flexibility, whole-system cookie-cutter designs, and lower quality service – or no service at all. snippet: Air & Water Quenches | Custom Extrusion Systems # Stacking Systems ### Stacking Systems #### Profile Stacker The Belco Profile Stacker is designed to stack the cut extrusions using an age oven racking shelf. The system will have a set of belts that move the material to the profile stacker centerline. The racks will be transferred under the belts and material will be picked up to load the empty racks. #### Rack Stacker The Belco Rack Stacker is designed to stack the fully loaded extrusion racks onto the Age Oven Conveyor to create a full batch to be aged. The rack stacker will pick up one rack and load it onto the corresponding conveyor lane for the operations. #### Profile De-Stacker The Belco Automatic Profile/Rack De-Stacker is designed to remove the stacks of racks loaded with profiles similar to the above stacker. The system will have a set of belts that move the material from the stacker centerline to the packing station roller conveyor. The racks will be transferred under the belts and to the rack storage system. #### Empty Rack Storage System The Belco Empty Rack Storage System will receive empty racks from the Rack De-Stacker and place the racks on to a multi-level storage conveyor. An automatic empty lifting and transporting device will pick up the rack and move it to its storage location. The empty rack stacker will stack tall racks on the upper level and the half racks on the lower level of the storage system.
